title: DIG Configuration
description: Persistent configuration for a local DIG install. Lives at $DIG_CONFIG, ~/.config/dig/config.json (Linux + macOS), or <repo>/dig.config.json (dev fallback). Loaded by scripts/dig_config.py and merged with env-var overrides at boot. All fields optional; missing fields (or explicit nulls) fall back to defaults — that way a config written before a key existed doesn't accidentally zap a newly-introduced default.

api.description: Backend (FastAPI/uvicorn) bind address + ports. The 'port' is plain HTTP; 'httpsPort' is the parallel TLS listener served by scripts/dig_tls_proxy.py (it terminates TLS and forwards to plain HTTP on 'port'). Both reach the same uvicorn process.

web.description: Frontend (Next.js dev server) bind address + ports. Same dual-port story as api: 'port' is HTTP, 'httpsPort' is HTTPS via dig_tls_proxy.py.

dataDir.description: Where uploads, cached parquet, run outputs, and the metadata SQLite live. Null = <repo>/data/.

logDir.description: Where dig-start.sh writes the rotated dig-api.log + dig-web.log + dig-tls-proxy.log streams. Null = /var/log/DIG (bootstrapped with sudo on first run; falls back to ~/Library/Logs/DIG on macOS or ~/.local/state/DIG/logs on Linux if sudo is declined).

log.description: Log rotation settings — applied per stream (api + web + tls-proxy each get their own rotated set via scripts/dig_log_rotate.py).

maxBytes.description: Per-file size cap. The rotator opens a new file (.log → .log.1) each time the active file crosses this size. Default 10 MB.

backupCount.description: Number of rotated files to keep. Older ones are pruned. Default 5 → 50 MB max per stream.

tls.description: Self-signed TLS settings. The cert is auto-generated at first start (scripts/dig_tls.py), covers localhost + hostname + every LAN IPv4 the box has, and is served on api.httpsPort + web.httpsPort by dig_tls_proxy.py.

enabled.description: Whether to start the TLS proxy. When false, only the http:// URLs are served.

certFile.description: Path to the TLS certificate (PEM). Null = ~/.config/dig/tls/dig.crt (auto-generated).

keyFile.description: Path to the TLS private key (PEM). Null = ~/.config/dig/tls/dig.key (auto-generated).

autoTrust.description: Attempt to install the cert into the system trust store on first start (one sudo prompt). The attempt happens exactly once — subsequent restarts skip it whether it succeeded or not. Re-trigger with `./scripts/dig_tls.py trust` at any time.

additionalSans.description: Extra DNS names or IP addresses to cover with the cert (e.g. a load-balancer hostname). Auto-included: localhost, machine hostname, hostname.local, 127.0.0.1, ::1, every non-loopback IPv4.

browserPreviewSampleRows.description: Default sample size for in-browser DuckDB-WASM preview when no per-pipeline override is set.
